recognize_zh: 周邊血中有小至中型淋巴球，核圓形或略不規則、染色質中度濃縮，細胞質少；骨髓切片被單一型小淋巴球瀰漫取代，大部分細胞呈強核染色（符合 cyclin D1），另一標記呈膜狀陽性，符合非結節型套細胞淋巴瘤並伴隨紅血球生成缺乏。
features: Panel A (PB): small-to-medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Panel A: one larger cell with more open chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Panel B (BM H&E): diffuse replacement by a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells; erythroid precursors not evident at this magnification
Panel C: strong nuclear staining in the majority of lymphoid cells (marker unlabeled; pattern fits cyclin D1 or SOX11)
Panel D: membranous/cytoplasmic staining in a subset of infiltrating cells (marker unlabeled)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating small-to-medium lymphocytes with round to mildly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy is diffusely infiltrated by monotonous small lymphoid cells with few recognizable erythroid precursors. Immunostains (markers not labeled in the figure) show strong nuclear staining in most lymphoid cells and membranous staining in a subset. In context, findings are consistent with leukemic non-nodal mantle cell lymphoma with extensive marrow involvement associated with pure red cell aplasia; confirmation by cyclin D1/SOX11 status and t(11;14) FISH is required.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD23+/CD200+ with smudge cells and proliferation centers and are cyclin D1 negative, although CLL is itself a common cause of PRCA.
SMZL cells may show villous projections and an intrasinusoidal marrow pattern and are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
T-LGL, a classic PRCA cause, shows cells with abundant cytoplasm and azurophilic granules and a CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ intrasinusoidal infiltrate.
